_note: Accepted parity differences owned by the templates stream (docs/plan/11-WP-PORT.md 5.4). Only that stream edits this file; the lead reviews every entry. An entry: {"route": "*" or a path, "section": a section key from the report ("*" for every section), "kind": "structure|text|links|pixels|timing", "match": a regular expression, "reason": why the difference is right, "owner": "templates"}. For structure, text and links, match is tested against each differing line (without its +/- sign) and the lines it matches are dropped from the diff. For pixels it is ignored: the entry accepts the section's pixel failure. For timing it names the prototype check line (its PASS/FAIL text) that may be re-run once.
